execution_order: Two original C warmups on AV28 step22; original C plus stored-D-hidden head preview; eight formal roles on each state, with a stored-D-hidden head control before each later state. Original C preview is additional; each state's formal original C remains in the 96 denominator.
numerical_gate: torch.equal for original C and stored-D-hidden head against immutable B1 outputs; any failure stops subsequent codec work and prevents all partial-state selection. Do not change tolerance, method precision, coefficients, bit sets or source to fit outputs.
backend: Pinned selected experiment WAN FP32 head strategy and conditional_frame_timestep=0.1; original loader TF32=True and default trainer cudnn benchmark=True/deterministic=False, scoped and restored.
timing_scope: Separate diagnostic CPU encode/decode, transfer and actual C readout records; no clean deployed speed claim and no extra timing-only trajectories.
selection: Only after complete 12-state acceptance: LOPO and one shared final bit direction per representation/rate/objective. Raw reconstruction is not a selection objective.
raw_references: Offline immutable inputs/teachers only; deployment-cache bytes and peak savings are not measured by this card.
